Ticket #4471 is marked known: one issue, one fix queued. The export says otherwise. Its reports hold two causes, and the fix covers only the first. Every number below is computed from the export at render time — the same logic the desk runs in causes.ts, not intake's guess.

Two causes. The fix queued for #4471 covers only one of them.

The table groups the ticket's unique reports (one id, one report) by cause, from each tenant's locale and booking form — never from meta.intakeTag, which is intake's guess from the reporter's browser and disagrees with the real cause for a chunk of reports.

The two problems

parser — the one the fix covers. The shared parser reads every date month first. Every tenant on file writes the day first, so their dates come out flipped. All tenants, every channel except booking-v3's form. This is the cause #4471 was merged for, and the queued fix is for it.

hint — the one without a ticket. The booking-v3 form prints MM/DD/YYYY under its date field. The tenant's people type what the hint tells them, month first, and the form then reads what they typed the tenant's way, day first. A second flip, in the form's own field, before the shared parser is ever reached. Only the booking-v3 tenants, only reports that arrived through the form. Merged into #4471 by subject like everything else, so it sits inside a ticket marked known — when the queued fix ships, these reports keep coming in.

What the desk read differently

The reports the desk read as a one-day move are counted where they were filed and footnoted under their cause (desk-notes.json), as the table shows. They change no count on this page.

Where the counts went

One issue per cause is filed in the public repo for this split, philipschm1tt/mega-s01e03-what-it-shows, each with the count of reports it covers. parser also keeps its place as #4471 in the ticket system; hint needs its own ticket there, and its own fix.

A big ticket is not always one bug. Merge early, but group by cause before the count is spent on a single fix.
